> Huáng Dékuān 黃德寬 and Xú Zàiguó 徐在國, eds. (2025), *Ānhuī dàxué
> cáng zhànguó zhújiǎn (3)* 安徽大学藏战国竹简（三）.

Professor Huáng Dékuān 黃德寬 and the Ānhuī Dàxué Hànzì Fāzhǎn yǔ Yìngyòng
Yánjiū Zhōngxīn 安徽大學漢字發展與應用研究中心 (Chinese Character Development

When referring to or displaying these images, cite the source edition and this

## Reuse

The permission recorded for this release establishes that these crops may be
published as part of the dataset. It does not establish a general open licence
for downstream image reuse. Users who wish to reuse manuscript images beyond
quotation, citation, or use of this dataset should obtain any permission
required from the rights holder.
